query: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WITH sp.specNumber AS ts,count(DISTINCT sec) AS secCnt OPTIONAL MATCH (src:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp1:Spec),(src)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(tgt:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp2:Spec) WHERE sp1.specNumber=ts AND sp2.specNumber=ts WITH ts,secCnt,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN src IS NOT NULL AND tgt IS NOT NULL THEN [src,tgt] ELSE null END) AS refCnt RETURN ts,secCnt,refCnt,CASE WHEN secCnt=0 THEN null ELSE round(100.0*refCnt/secCnt)/100.0 END AS refDensity
